boss_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite source sheet, crisp cartoon pixel art top-down 3/4 RPG, transparent background. ONE original final boss called The Silence, no text. Compact human-like shadow conductor, large faceless porcelain mask with a single narrow vertical dark split, no mouth, asymmetrical high collar, ragged dark indigo long coat, two clearly visible gloved hands, floating short spectral feet, broken silver tuning-fork-like crest on shoulder, small pale blue and violet details, readable dark outline. Not a reaper, no scythe, no weapon, no hat, no giant wings. Consistent design proportions and colors in all poses. EXACT 4 columns x 8 rows, 32 isolated full body poses, generous transparent gaps, no contact shadows, no floor, no labels. Columns ALWAYS front facing south / back north / left profile / right profile. Rows: 1 neutral idle with arms low; 2 moving stride left foot advanced coat trailing; 3 moving stride opposite foot advanced; 4 attack anticipation both hands pulled to chest; 5 attack releasing force palms thrust forward toward facing direction; 6 recoiling from damage chest tilted back; 7 vulnerable kneeling with mask lowered and arms sagging; 8 phase transformation arms raised above head coat flared open. Fully contained poses same scale all cells, do not create rings or particles around characters. At final reduction body approximately 36 pixels tall, simple large pixel clusters with 3 tones per material, no gradients or blur. Use hand-designed readable animation silhouettes. All 32 poses must be complete.
